name: remote-jobs-scraper
title: Remote Jobs Scraper – Remotive, Remote OK, Jobicy, Arbeitnow
description: Remote job postings from four public job-board APIs (Remotive, Remote OK, Jobicy, Arbeitnow) in one normalized schema, de-duplicated across boards so the same job is never billed twice. Keyword, company, location, salary and posted-date filters.
